run.final_text:
{"status": "answered", "answer": "There are five missing-fact findings on record, covering three parties.

- **I-006 Meridian Holdings I S.à r.l.** has one finding, MF-R001, against requirement FR-07 (the owners of the recipient up to its ultimate owners, for an ownership-based limitation-on-benefits claim; rule R-02 v2026.1, not mandatory). Assessment A-R012 found it on component D-001-A on 2026-10-08. The owners cannot be established because of a circular holding with Meridian Holdings II (I-018) declared from 2026-08-01, and change case K-006 on clearance CL-006 is open.
- **I-014 Client account 7731** has two findings, both under rule R-01 v2026.1 and both mandatory. The account owns 37.5% of the income Sterling Nominees receives.
  - MF-001 is against FR-03 (the tax certification of each underlying owner and its share, for an intermediary or flow-through recipient). It is an open item of clearance CL-007 (admitted with open items), recorded 2025-03-15.
  - MF-R002 is against FR-02 (tax certification of the recipient, valid on the payment date). Assessment A-R014 found it on component D-001-A on 2026-10-08: there is no certification on file and no recorded tax residence.
- **I-015 Bertrange Capital S.A.** has two findings, both against FR-02 (rule R-01 v2026.1, mandatory). Form F-015 ended on 2025-12-31 and no new form was received.
  - MF-002 is an open item of the withdrawn clearance CL-015W, recorded 2026-01-01.
  - MF-R003 was found by assessment A-R017 on component D-001-A on 2026-10-08.

The clearance findings and the assessment findings are separate records and are not merged, so the same gap can appear once as each. The two Bertrange findings are the same gap recorded twice.

result.label: Missing Fact Finding
result.definition: An explicit record that a required fact was not available when an assessment was made.

steps.executed:
SELECT m.finding_id AS finding, m.about_party, i.display_name AS party_name,
       m.unmet_requirement AS requirement, r.description AS requirement_text, r.rule_id AS rule, r.version_label AS version, r.mandatory,
       m.description, m.recorded_on,
       CASE WHEN m.clearance_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'clearance' ELSE 'assessment' END AS found_by,
       m.clearance_id AS clearance, c.clearance_status, m.assessment_id AS assessment, a.subject_event AS component,
       'clearance.missing_fact_finding:' || m.finding_id AS source_ref
FROM clearance.missing_fact_finding m
JOIN rulebook.fact_requirement r ON r.req_id = m.unmet_requirement
LEFT JOIN investor_register.investor i ON i.inv_no = m.about_party
LEFT JOIN clearance.clearance c ON c.clearance_id = m.clearance_id
LEFT JOIN clearance.obligation_assessment a ON a.assessment_id = m.assessment_id
ORDER BY m.about_party, m.finding_id
